description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. We are looking to fill this vital role quickly with a candidate who is passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership position. Join a team committed to fostering a positive and effective environment for both residents and staff.
requirements: Proven leadership experience in a nursing management role
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation offered between $85,000 and $95,000 per year.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. The ideal candidate will be an RN with a passion for delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in assisting the Director of Nursing with the overall management of nursing operations. Your responsibilities will include ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, overseeing daily clinical activities, and contributing to the development and implementation of care plans. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
Ability to effectively manage and mentor nursing staff

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $36-$40, providing an excellent opportunity for a professional passionate about resident care and compliance.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a vital role in assessing resident needs, developing comprehensive care plans, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Your expertise will contribute significantly to the quality of care provided, working collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal outcomes for residents. We are looking for a detail-oriented individual committed to upholding the highest standards of healthcare.
requirements: Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and care planning processes
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations related to long-term care
Experience in a skilled nursing facility setting

description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Interim MDS Coordinator (RN Preferred) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This interim opportunity offers a chance to make an immediate impact by ensuring accurate and timely resident assessments and care plans.As the Interim MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations, and collaborating with the interdisciplinary team to develop comprehensive care plans. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining high standards of resident care and facility operations.This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with a strong understanding of MDS guidelines and a commitment to quality healthcare. Join a supportive environment focused on resident well-being and clinical excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas (or ability to obtain)
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator
Strong knowledge of MDS 3.0 and federal/state regulations
Experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) or Long-Term Care (LTC) setting
